subject: gerenuk antelope
title: This Antelope May Never Drink Water in Its Entire Life

scenes.text: This antelope may never take a single drink in its life.
The gerenuk lives in the dry thornbush country of East Africa, where water is hard to find.
Its trick is its menu. It eats only leaves, shoots and fruit, and gets its water from them.
To reach the best leaves, it stands up on its hind legs, neck stretched like a giraffe.
It rests its forelegs on a branch and pulls down leaves six to eight feet off the ground.
No water hole needed. It drinks its dinner.

description:
The gerenuk is an East African antelope that does not need to drink water.
It gets moisture from leaves, and stands on its hind legs to reach branches six to eight feet high.
Could you go a lifetime without a drink? Tell us below.
first_comment: The gerenuk drinks its dinner. What other animal lives without water holes?
